pages.title_tag: Nissan Note Import Eligibility Australia | Import Check
pages.intro_copy: Short answer today: no. The Note is Nissan's small hatch, and the e-POWER version is the interesting one, a petrol engine that never drives the wheels and only charges a battery that does. It drives like an EV without the charging problem, and Nissan Australia never brought it here. Look the Note up on ROVER and you will find seven model reports that still read In Force, which is why you will see it described as importable elsewhere. Every one of them is built on a single SEVS entry that has since left the register. A model report with no live SEVS entry underneath it is not a pathway in. This page rechecks that every day, so if a live approval appears it will show up here.
pages.meta_description: Can a Nissan Note or Note e-POWER be imported to Australia? Right now, no. Every approval on the register rests on a SEVS entry that has been removed. Rechecked daily.
